BAD-TriSpinner

Like a lot of the BAD projects, this one came from an interest in some math thing. In this case, working out points in relation to other points. Looking at the code, it seems similar to what WorldFather does for its relative points, but WorldFather does it much better.
I do still enjoy this project. It needs a rebuild (especially because of the speed limit) but the BAD projects will not be revisited.
